label: FS.com XGS-ONU-25-20NI XGS-PON SFP+ ONU
description: XGS-PON ONU built into an SFP+ module (Cortina CA8271A, Saturn SDK Linux, SC/APC BOSA) that presents a 2500BASE-X or 10GBASE-R host interface to the router's SFP+ cage; XGS-PON line rate 9.953 Gbit/s symmetric with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over telnet or its TTL serial console.
